### Summary of Solution & Bug Fix Report

We have successfully resolved the Windows quote-stripping regression in `run_shell_command` on Windows platforms.

#### Root Cause Analyzed
`run_shell_command` traditionally ran command execution strings using Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`) as default, which silently drops unescaped double quotes when passing raw CLI arguments down to native executable boundaries. PowerShell 7 (`pwsh.exe`) properly resolves this quote preservation issue automatically. To adopt `pwsh.exe` preferentially, we refactored `resolveExecutable` from asynchronous to synchronous to support synchronous fallback checking within `getShellConfiguration`.
